intro: July 6 is the first post-holiday session and a convergence of three binary determinations that will set the tone for the full portfolio activation planned for July 7. BUY regime (upgraded July 2: NFP 119K Goldilocks + SPX/VIX dual gate) is intact and unchallenged by any new data. The framework is now in 'holding pattern' with three open sequencers that must resolve before position sizing can be activated: (1) NVDA Stop Day 2 binary — July 6 US close above $195 isolates Stop Day 1; below $195 = mandatory exit at July 7 open; (2) BTC Gate 1 — $61,986 at last UTC snapshot, $14 below $62,000; tonight's UTC midnight close (July 3/4) is the first Gate 1 candidate; (3) SK Hynix Stop Day 1 ISOLATED (July 3 KST: ₩2,552,000 +10.88%) — hold into ADR listing July 10; KOSPI Gate 1 (>8,500) and SK Hynix Gate 2 (₩2,700,000) are the full-size add prerequisites. SPCX Day 9 (July 6) volume is the clearance check. July 7 remains the full portfolio activation date for NVDA full-size add, GOOGL/META adds, QQQ puts exit — but all are conditional on July 6 resolution events going in the right direction. Crypto markets trade continuously through the holiday weekend; monitor BTC UTC midnight closes July 3 and July 4.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: Stop Day 2 binary July 6; full activation conditional July 7
ideas.idea: Hold half-size. Stop Day 2 binary determines everything at the July 6 US close: ABOVE $195 = Stop Day 1 isolated; position holds into July 7 full-size add check. BELOW $195 = STOP DAY 2 = mandatory full exit at July 7 open, zero discretion. Holiday tape ~$194.44 is $0.56 above the stop — razor thin margin. China H200 chip restriction potentially easing (DOC/BIS rulemaking under review) is the primary upside catalyst for July 6 session: if confirmed, removes the single largest near-term overhang on NVDA China revenue ($7–10B annualized). Full-size add at July 7 open only if Stop Day 1 is isolated AND NVDA opens above $200 AND SPX futures >7,460 AND VIX pre-open <17 at 9:25 AM ET July 7.
ideas.why: NVDA holiday tape ~$194.44 is above the $195 stop on a closing basis by $0.74 (from July 2 close $193.70). But the Stop Day 2 binary is determined on the July 6 US session CLOSE, not the holiday tape — a morning gap-up to $197+ on China H200 news could easily push July 6 close above $195; conversely, any new negative semiconductor headline could push July 6 close below $195. Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story has NO impact on NVDA HBM4 Blackwell supply chain and has been well-understood by the market after July 2-3. The China H200 reopening catalyst — if confirmed in regulatory filings — is the most significant fundamental positive for NVDA in 2026 outside of the $91B Q2 FY27 earnings guide.
ideas.trigger: July 6 US close: ABOVE $195 = Stop Day 1 isolated; hold into July 7 full-size add decision. July 7 full-size add check at 9:25 AM ET: NVDA above $200 AND SPX futures >7,460 AND VIX pre-open <17 simultaneously. If all three: add to full-size at July 7 open. If any fails: hold half-size only, do not add.
ideas.risk: July 6 US close below $195 (any close at current levels or lower triggers Stop Day 2 = mandatory full exit July 7 open, no discretion); China H200 reopening report proves premature or is denied; new Apple/CXMT expansion to HBM4 supply chain news over the July 4 weekend; SPX rolls below 7,460 on overnight shock.

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.timeframe: Gate 1: tonight's UTC midnight; Gate 2: July 4 UTC midnight; re-entry July 6 open if both confirmed
ideas.idea: BTC ~$61,986 at last UTC snapshot = $14 below Gate 1 ($62,000). The two-gate sequence for re-entry is within reach for the first time in 12+ sessions. Crypto trades continuously through the US holiday weekend — monitor: (1) July 3/4 UTC midnight close above $62,000 = Gate 1 confirmed; (2) July 4/5 UTC midnight close above $62,000 = Gate 2 confirmed; (3) IBIT net inflow confirmation (T+2 lag; earliest read July 6 AM via Bloomberg ETF data). IF all three confirmed: re-entry activated for July 6 open. Size: 20–25% of crypto allocation. DO NOT enter without both UTC midnight gates AND IBIT confirmation — holiday-thin tape momentum is not a substitute for the institutional demand signal.
ideas.why: Second consecutive intraday breach above $62,000 (July 2: $62,210 high; July 3: $62,040 high) confirms buying pressure at the gate level. Ascending-low structure intact: daily lows July 1 $57,802 → July 2 $59,584 → July 3 $61,232 = each session's low is higher. Goldilocks NFP (119K, July 2) + US BUY regime upgrade is the most constructive macro backdrop for BTC since the April 2024 halving. No US institutional selling pressure during the holiday gap (markets closed July 3–4). The sequential gate mechanism (two consecutive UTC midnight closes above $62,000) exists specifically to filter out holiday-thin momentum spikes from genuine institutional re-accumulation.
ideas.trigger: Check BTC UTC midnight price (00:00 UTC July 4, then 00:00 UTC July 5) via Crypto.com or Coinbase. Gate 1 = July 3/4 midnight close above $62,000. Gate 2 = July 4/5 midnight close above $62,000. Gate 3 = at least one confirmed positive IBIT net inflow. All three required before any re-entry. Earliest re-entry: July 6 open (US markets reopen). If Gate 1 fires but Gate 2 fails (BTC dips below $62K on July 4): reset sequence, watch-only.
ideas.risk: BTC retreats from $61,986 on holiday weekend profit-taking or Korea-shock crypto contagion (crypto never closes; 24/7 risk during the US holiday gap); Gate 1 fires but Gate 2 fails (single-session bounce, not sustained demand); IBIT outflows continue through July 7 (no institutional demand signal confirmed); holiday-thin tape amplifies moves in both directions.

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: 5 KRX sessions to July 10 ADR listing (SKHY, Nasdaq, $29.4B)
ideas.idea: Stop Day 1 ISOLATED on July 3 KST close (₩2,552,000 +10.88%): two-consecutive-close stop protocol has RESET. Hold half-size into July 10 Nasdaq SKHY ADR listing ($29.4B; BofA/Goldman/Citi/JPMorgan). CONVICTION RESTORED TO MEDIUM from low. July 6 KST session (Monday) is the next determination point: watch for KOSPI Gate 1 (>8,500; currently 8,088.34, 5.1% below) and SK Hynix Gate 2 (₩2,700,000; currently 5.8% below) progress. NO full-size add until BOTH gates cleared simultaneously. Stop protocol reset: a NEW Stop Day 1 would require a FUTURE KST close below ₩2,540,000. DO NOT average down below Gate 2.
ideas.why: The forced-short-covering reversal from ₩2,301,000 (July 2 close) to ₩2,552,000 (July 3 close) = +10.88% in a single session confirms the ADR underwriter bid is actively defending the position. The underwriter ceiling at ₩2,723,000 (July 3 intraday high) is only ₩23,000 above Gate 2 — the two levels are converging as the July 10 listing approaches. KOSPI +5.76% with buy-side VI sidecar (1:47 PM KST) confirms institutional re-entry into Korean equities broadly, not just short-covering. Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story has NOT expanded to HBM4 — the structural thesis (SK Hynix = dominant HBM4 supplier for NVDA Blackwell) is intact. The two-session net change (July 1 close ₩2,584,000 → July 3 close ₩2,552,000 = -₩32,000 = -1.24%) demonstrates volatility normalization, not fundamental deterioration.
ideas.trigger: July 6 KST session (Monday, KRX open 9:00 AM KST = 00:00 UTC July 6): monitor intraday. If KOSPI breaches 8,500 and SK Hynix holds above ₩2,700,000 simultaneously on a closing basis → full-size add. Otherwise: hold half-size only. New Stop Day 1 threshold: ₩2,540,000 (any FUTURE KST close below this level). ADR listing July 10: the underwriter ceiling (₩2,723,000 today) should lift as offering price finalizes — monitor for ceiling shift in the July 6–9 sessions.
ideas.risk: Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM negotiations confirmed over July 4 weekend news cycle — if announced as a done deal (not just negotiations), Korean market re-prices mobile DRAM risk more severely; July 6 KST opens below ₩2,540,000 on weekend news = new Stop Day 1 triggered immediately; KOSPI fails to sustain recovery (Gate 1 >8,500 remains unreached); ADR underwriter ceiling doesn't lift before listing, capping upside below Gate 2.

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: Day 9 (July 6) volume check; Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (Day 10); re-entry gate $185 est. July 9–11
ideas.idea: Step aside HIGH conviction — DO NOT BUY SPCX on July 7 Nasdaq 100 inclusion spike. Day 9 (July 6) volume is the critical clearance indicator: target below 20M in the first hour (9:30–10:30 AM ET) and below 30M for the full Day 9 session. Day 10 (July 7): ~$4.3B QQQ/QQQM passive inflows from Nasdaq 100 effective inclusion; Russell 1000 June 26 template (Day 4: $158.40 intraday → $152.15 close, fully absorbed) is the base case. Monitor: if Day 10 closes ABOVE $165 AND volume is below 15M (distribution nearly done), clearance may arrive Day 11 (July 8) rather than Day 12 (July 9).
ideas.why: Korea-contagion holiday-gap risk (the $6.16 IG floor buffer that was the July 2 primary tail risk) has substantially diminished: KOSPI +5.76% and SK Hynix Stop Day 1 isolated on July 3 KST confirms Korean risk-off has not extended into the holiday gap. July 6 US open should start at $157–$162 range, preserving the IG floor margin. The step-aside discipline means zero capital at risk during the holiday gap — exactly the correct posture given the bond distribution mechanics and the unhedgeable nature of the July 3–5 gap. The only actionable change from here is Day 9 volume confirmation.
ideas.trigger: Day 9 (July 6): monitor first-hour volume at 9:30–10:30 AM ET; if below 20M in first hour and below 30M total, clearance is accelerating. Day 10 (July 7): DO NOT re-enter on inclusion spike; monitor close vs. Day 9 close for post-inclusion distribution pattern. Re-entry gate: volume <5M/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions (est. Day 11–12, July 8–9) THEN two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. Alert level on July 6 open: if SPCX gaps below $154 (IG buffer narrows to $4), heightened monitoring required.
ideas.risk: Day 9 (July 6) volume comes in above 40M on new negative news (Starship incident, SpaceX regulatory item, or broader risk-off); $150 IG floor tested on July 6 open due to residual Korea-contagion; Nasdaq 100 inclusion (Day 10) fully absorbed intraday with SPCX closing below $157.54 (July 2 official close), extending the distribution low; clearance delays to Day 14+ (July 14+) pushing re-entry window past the September 2 earnings ramp-up.

ideas.name: Alphabet Inc.
ideas.idea: GOOGL position from July 2 open entry held. Day 5 of Dow rebalancing systematic demand from 44+ Dow-tracking ETFs continues — inclusion was effective June 30; rebalancing flows span 5–7 sessions. Add more at July 7 open on any dip to $350–$355. Goldilocks NFP (119K) + ISM 54.0 (July 1) confirm the Goldilocks ad market narrative: business activity expanding, US consumer employed — ideal for Google Search and Cloud AI revenue. July 6 is a hold session (no action); July 7 is the add session.
ideas.why: GOOGL's Dow inclusion creates price-weighting rebalancing demand (~7x Verizon's prior weighting) — any dip between sessions is systematically purchased by Dow-tracking ETFs. Korea shock has zero direct impact on GOOGL: Search monetization and Cloud AI infrastructure are domestic US revenue. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the first full quarter reflecting Dow inclusion flows and AI Search monetization — GOOGL is in a structural 'buy the dip' regime going into Q2.
ideas.trigger: Hold July 6. July 7 open: add GOOGL on any dip to $350–$355 at 9:25 AM ET. Stop: $339 (below June 30 low). Target: $380–$390 pre-Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: DOJ antitrust search remedies (user choice screen) materially reduce Search revenue before Q2 earnings; AI Mode Search cannibalizes ad clicks faster than AI ad placement compensates; SPX breaks below 7,300 on unexpected July 6/7 catalyst.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: META position from July 2 open entry held. AI ad targeting improvements compound instantaneously across 3.3B daily active users with zero semiconductor supply chain exposure to Korea shock. Goldilocks NFP (119K) confirms US consumers remain employed and spending — directly constructive for META's ad revenue model. Add on any July 7 weakness. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the first full-AI-feature quarter at scale — setup for 'beat and raise.' Hold July 6; add July 7.
ideas.why: META's FCF $60B+ annual run rate makes it the most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in a Warsh hawkish hold environment through 2027. Every AI ad targeting improvement reaches 3.3B users in real-time with no enterprise sales cycle delay. The company has no exposure to Korean memory, no semiconductor supply chain complexity, and no meaningful geopolitical overhang from the Apple/CXMT story. Q2 2026 is the first full quarter of AI-at-scale monetization — setup for 'beat and raise.'
ideas.trigger: Hold July 6. July 7 — add META on any weakness at open. Stop: prior week low. Target: new ATH before Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: EU AI Act creates unexpectedly large discriminatory compliance costs; Apple iOS ATT restricts cross-app targeting further; Q2 earnings miss on ad revenue; SPX breaks below 7,300.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: Buy MU on any dip to $1,150–$1,200 at July 6 open or intraday. The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story is a MICRON POSITIVE: mobile DRAM share shifting to CXMT (Pentagon 1260H blacklisted) amplifies US government AI procurement mandate for Micron's Idaho HBM4 — DoD cannot use CXMT. $50B Q4 FY26 guide confirmed; HBM4 sold out through 2026; no forced-exit overhang; no ADR mechanics. July 6 is the first post-holiday session and may produce a sympathetic dip opportunity if Korean semiconductor sector contagion lingers at the open.
ideas.why: MU has the cleanest setup of any AI semi heading into July 6: no stop protocol, no gate conditions, no distribution mechanics. The Korea shock (SK Hynix -10.96% July 2) created a sympathetic MU dip that has not fully reversed — if July 6 US open sees Korean risk-off follow-through before KOSPI's recovery is priced in by US investors, MU may open below $1,200 and represent a tactical entry. The HBM4 demand is structural (NVDA Blackwell supply chain confirmed through 2026) and MU's CHIPS Act Idaho fab advantage becomes MORE strategic as CXMT blacklist status makes Chinese DRAM non-compliant for US government AI procurement.
ideas.trigger: Buy MU at $1,150–$1,200 at July 6 open or intraday on any Korea-sympathetic dip. If MU opens above $1,200 and no dip materializes in the first hour: wait for natural pullback within 1–2 weeks. Stop: $1,100. Target: $1,350–$1,400 through September Q4 FY26 earnings.
ideas.risk: HBM demand peaks earlier than H1 2027 as AI model efficiency gains reduce memory per compute; Samsung aggressive HBM4 pricing to defend market share; MU Q4 FY26 guide miss at September earnings (the primary downside scenario); Korea semiconductor contagion extends to US DRAM on new HBM4-specific negative headline.
